title: Halting during the setup phase
statement: Let $P$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes, and let $Q$ be another such machine. Choose a state $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ of $P$, a work tape index $j$, and states $q_{\mathrm{entry}},q_{\mathrm{acc}},q_{\mathrm{rej}}$ of $Q$. If $P$ is halted after $T_P$ steps on Boolean input $z$, and has not visited $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ at any earlier time, then for every Boolean word $w$ of length at least $T_P$, running the guess-and-run machine on $w$ from its initial configuration gives exactly the configuration reached by $P$ after $T_P$ steps, with its state placed in the pre-phase of the combined machine.
hypotheses_covered: $P,Q$ are deterministic machines with $k$ Boolean work tapes
$z$ is a Boolean input and $T_P$ is a natural number
The configuration reached by $P$ after $T_P$ steps is halted
$w$ is a Boolean word of length at least $T_P$
